§10.5.3A.new: A sanction must not be imposed in respect of a failure to report where the change of circumstances in question would have increased the award.

transitional.reporting_changes: Changes occurring before 1 March 2026 use the reporting period in force on the date of the change.
transitional.determination_changes: Paragraphs 1, 3 and 4 apply to determinations made on or after 1 March 2026.
transitional.spanning_period: Claims spanning 1 March 2026 use the figures in force on each day of the period and are apportioned under §7.4.3.
